headline: Electric Motorcycle Manufacturers Challenge Global Giants on Vietnam Streets
summary: Rising fuel prices are accelerating Vietnam's adoption of electric two-wheelers, supporting domestic manufacturers and challenging established foreign motorcycle producers.
why: Vietnam is one of the world's largest two-wheeler markets, making its transition to electric power a model for regional urban transport shifts.

impacts.name: Vietnam
impacts.why: Rapid adoption of electric motorcycles supports domestic manufacturing growth.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
